title: Daddy Chill
blurb: 'What the hell is even that? DADDY CHILL' — the legendary line from an amateur web series that the internet elevated to scripture. The delivery is so wooden, so committed, and so completely unbothered by acting that it looped its way into permanent meme canon. Play it when someone needs to calm down immediately and inexplicably.
origin: From the viral 'What the hell is even that?' web-series clip.
